nary_nodes.label: Existing accounts blocked from January 2027

nary_nodes.label: France leads in protecting children

nary_nodes.label: Ban threatens freedom and privacy
evidence: "The global rollout of social media bans represents a serious threat to the freedom and privacy of millions of internet users across the world.
